A change in your pet’s breathing is never something to ignore 🐶💨
Fast breathing or unusual breathing sounds might seem harmless but they could be early signs of respiratory infections or even heart problems 🫁⚠️
Watch out for these signs 👇
🐾 Persistent coughing or wheezing
🐾 Rapid or labored breathing
🐾 Unusual tiredness or low energy
🐾 Changes in breathing while resting
At Columbia Animal Hospital we believe every sign tells a story and early diagnosis can make all the difference 🩺❤️
Don't wait for a small change to become a serious problem

Sudden weight changes?
There's always a reason 🐾
Whether your pet is losing weight despite eating normally or gaining weight without any obvious changes, it could be a sign of an underlying health issue! 🩺
Possible causes include:
🐾 Hormonal imbalances
🐾 Diabetes
🐾 Digestive disorders
🐾 Kidney or liver problems
Every Sign Tells a Story ❤️
At Columbia Animal Hospital, we help uncover what's behind the changes through proper examination and diagnostic testing

Vomiting was just the beginning of Jelly's story 🚨
2-year-old Jelly arrived at Columbia Animal Hospital suffering from vomiting and bloody vaginal discharge with pus🐶💔
An ultrasound revealed Pyometra a serious uterine infection requiring urgent surgery 🩺
Our team successfully removed the infected uterus and today Jelly is healthy and feeling great again ❤️🐾
Early diagnosis can save lives 💙

From the first warning sign to emergency treatment🚨
Urinary retention in cats can become life-threatening if not treated quickly ⚠️
🐾 Stage 1 – Early Stage
Your cat may appear completely normal
🚩 Stage 2 – Warning Signs
Frequent litter box visits with little or no urine and possible blood in the urine
🩺 Stage 3 – Diagnosis
Veterinary examination and tests to identify the cause
🏥 Stage 4 – Treatment
Urgent intervention to relieve the blockage and stabilize your cat
At Columbia Animal Hospital we're here to provide the care your cat needs ❤️🐾
If your cat can't urinate don't wait! Seek emergency veterinary care immediately⚠️

Bad breath can be more than just an unpleasant smell 🦷
It could be a sign of plaque buildup gum inflammation dental infection or other oral health problems😟
Watch for signs like 👇
- Red or swollen gums
- Yellow or brown buildup on the teeth
- Difficulty chewing
- Drooling more than usual
- Persistent bad breath
Every sign tells a story and your pet’s mouth might be telling you it’s time for a dental check 🩺
Visit Columbia Animal Hospital for a proper dental examination 🐾

A full bowl can say more than you think🐾
